hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -qE 'just +(check|test)[^|;]*\|[^|;]*(grep +-[[:alpha:]]*c|wc\b|grep[^|;]*\b(PASS|FAIL)\b)' && printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Run it once and read the output: the exit code already reports pass/fail, so counting the PASS lines or grepping for FAIL says nothing the exit status does not."}}' || true

jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -qE '(^|[^[:alnum:]_.-])python3' && printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Use uv run python, never the system python3, for anything pointed at this repository (see the Git section of CLAUDE.md)."}}' || true
